This fungal disease (caused by *Cercospora coffeicola* on coffee or similar pathogens on other crops) produces exactly these round, eye-like necrotic spots on leaves. The multiple discrete circular lesions with the classic concentric ring pattern perfectly match Brown Eye Spot symptomology.
